title: Write the deployment procedure
task_summary: Write the repeatable build, run, health-verify, and rollback deployment procedure for the books app, accepted by executing it end to end.

approved_outcomes.outcome: The procedure documents building and running the app with environment-variable configuration.
The procedure verifies a deployment through the health endpoint.
The procedure rolls back to the previous deployment when verification fails.
Acceptance is one executed end-to-end deployment and rollback on a clean checkout.

coherent_deliverables.title: Deliver the deployment procedure
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: One operational capability verified as a whole; the rollback is part of the same procedure.

acceptance_evidence: One executed deployment with health verification and one executed rollback on a clean checkout.
